Job Title: E-Commerce PPC Specialist (Amazon Focused)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: Flexible, with partial overlap in U.S. business hours

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced Amazon PPC & Full-Stack Marketing Expert to drive sales growth and performance across multiple digital channels. This role combines strategic marketing execution with hands-on campaign management across Amazon Ads, Facebook Ads, and Email Marketing.

The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, and comfortable owning full-funnel marketing activities — from ad optimization and campaign strategy to audience targeting and performance reporting. You will play a key role in improving ROI, increasing brand visibility, and supporting long-term eCommerce growth.

Responsibilities

Amazon PPC Management

  • Develop, launch, and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns to drive traffic, conversions, and ROI.
  • Conduct keyword research, bid management, and product targeting optimization.
  • Analyze campaign data to make informed scaling decisions and reduce wasted spend.
  • Collaborate with the team on seasonal strategies, promotions, and new product launches.

Marketplace Operations & Support

  • Manage product listings, pricing, and performance metrics on Amazon Seller Central.
  • Monitor reviews, customer feedback, and inventory to maintain listing quality.
  • Identify marketplace trends and improvement opportunities to maximize sales.

Full-Stack Digital Marketing

  • Plan, execute, and optimize Facebook Ads to complement Amazon traffic and conversion goals.
  • Build and manage email marketing campaigns (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar) to increase retention and lifetime value.
  • Develop cohesive cross-channel campaigns ensuring consistency in brand voice and performance tracking.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Generate weekly and monthly performance reports across all marketing channels.
  • Use data insights to optimize campaigns, reduce costs, and increase overall ROI.
  • Communicate key learnings and recommendations to the client and internal stakeholders.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

You’re a performance-driven marketer who thrives on both strategy and execution. You understand how each marketing channel impacts the customer journey and know how to use data to make smart decisions. You enjoy working independently, testing new approaches, and continuously improving campaign results.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC campaigns.
  • Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and marketplace advertising tools.
  • Proven experience running Facebook Ads and email marketing campaigns.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and act on insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Ideal Experience & Skills

  • Experience in eCommerce or consumer product marketing.
  • Familiarity with Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or other performance marketing platforms.
  • Strong copywriting skills for ad creatives and email campaigns.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and A/B testing.
  • Prior experience working with fast-scaling D2C brands.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day begins by reviewing key metrics across Amazon, Facebook, and email channels. You’ll optimize active campaigns, test new ad variations, and adjust strategies based on performance data. Throughout the day, you’ll collaborate with the client team, manage product listings, refine targeting, and prepare reports that showcase growth opportunities.

Every action you take contributes directly to sales growth and marketing efficiency.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Increase in ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) and overall campaign profitability.
  • Growth in Amazon sales volume and conversion rate.
  • Improvement in CTR and engagement on Facebook Ads.
  • Consistent increase in email open rates and revenue per campaign.
  • Timely reporting and actionable data insights delivered weekly.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Interview with Pavago Recruitment Team.
  2. Client Interview with the Hiring Manager.
  3. Practical Task: Review sample campaign data and provide an optimization strategy.
  4. Final Discussion & Offer.

Bist du es leid, als 360-Grad-Berater den halben Tag damit zu verbringen, Firmen hinterherzurennen, um mühsam neue Mandate zu akquirieren? Liebst du die Jagd nach Top-Talenten, aber hasst das „Klinkenputzen“ im B2B-Vertrieb?

raw.description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company on a mission to make work simpler.

Since 2006, we’ve been building game-changing products that tackle HR and IT’s biggest challenges.

Workleap operates two distinct product lines:

  • The Workleap Platform, an AI-powered HR solution designed to drive team performance and boost employee engagement.
  • ShareGate, the leading Microsoft 365 migration and governance solution, trusted by IT professionals worldwide for its unmatched simplicity.

Today, more than 20,000 companies rely on Workleap products to grow, lead, and operate with confidence.

We’re builders at heart, with a clear purpose: to craft the simplest products that deliver exceptional value for our customers. Period.

Job Description

So, what will your new role look like?

As a Senior Product Designer on ShareGate Migrate, you’ll work in a close product trio (PM, Tech Lead, Designer) to shape the experience of a product used in high-impact, operationally sensitive projects. You will design solutions that help IT administrators navigate complex migration scenarios with clarity and confidence. The work spans strategy and execution: defining problem spaces, shaping flows and interactions, refining UI details, and iterating quickly based on learning. You’ll thoughtfully explore where AI can enhance the experience and whether it’s simplifying planning, surfacing insights, or guiding teams through technical decisions. This is an opportunity to work on meaningful challenges that have a real impact on how organizations evolve their digital workplaces. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy complexity, collaborate naturally with engineers and PMs, and care about delivering dependable, thoughtful user experiences that scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end design within your product team, from framing problems to refining final interactions;
  • Turn ambiguous or technical workflows into intuitive, purposeful experiences for IT professionals;
  • Design flows, interfaces, and interactions that simplify Microsoft 365 and cloud-migration scenarios;
  • Collaborate closely with PMs, engineers, and subject-matter experts to clarify scope and align on strategy;
  • Prototype, test, and iterate quickly to validate assumptions and strengthen solutions;
  • Use data, customer feedback, and product insights to guide decisions and improve outcomes;
  • Explore AI-driven opportunities that make migration and governance workflows more efficient, predictive, and reliable;
  • Contribute to improving the design workflow with new tools, innovation, and new methodologies;
  • Contribute to the evolution of our design system and help ensure consistency across ShareGate.

A typical week?  

You’ll move fluidly between strategic exploration, hands-on design, and close collaboration. Expect to:

  • Shape product direction during trio planning and discovery activities;
  • Translate customer needs and business opportunities into clear flows, wireframes, and prototypes;
  • Partner with engineering to refine scope, understand constraints, and uphold design quality throughout development;
  • Present in-progress work to teams and stakeholders for feedback during critiques and async reviews;
  • Review migration data, support trends, and user behavior patterns to inform decisions;
  • Refine interaction details and ensure thoughtful, cohesive hand-offs;
  • Document rationale and communicate decisions effectively across teams;
  • Utilize AI tools that increase your effectiveness in understanding our customers;
  • Prototype with AI prototyping tools regularly to communicate, test, and validate solutions.

You’ll have autonomy, ownership, and a team that values thoughtful execution and continuous learning.

What does your future team look like?

This is a role where you can influence not only how the product works today, but also how it evolves over the next several years.

Qualifications

  • Strong user instincts and confidence navigating ambiguous, technically complex problem spaces;

  • Experience designing or contributing to AI-powered experiences;
  • Clear communicator with strong storytelling skills, comfortable influencing product and engineering partners;

Salary range: $120–$145k CAD.

Who we are

We’re a team of curious minds and bold builders, brought together by a shared drive to make work simpler - and better - for everyone. Challenges fuel our creativity, fast-paced environments keep us sharp, and pushing boundaries is just part of how we operate. We believe the best ideas come from experimentation, rapid learning, and even the occasional discomfort - that’s where growth happens.

Since 2006, we’ve been rethinking the way teams work, blending creativity and tech to solve real problems in IT and HR. We move quickly, we learn constantly, and we always keep our customers at the center of what we do. If you're a proactive thinker who takes ownership, loves to collaborate, and isn’t afraid to leap into the unknown - you’ll fit right in.

At Workleap, we build together, we trust each other, and we support each other in success or failure. You will be able to express yourself, evolve and develop your creativity in an environment that will adapt to your daily life and your needs.

SoftSnow is looking for a seasoned client-facing professional to own and drive client engagements from kickoff through delivery. In this AI Strategist role, you will be responsible for owning client relationships, translating business challenges into actionable project plans, and ensuring high-quality execution in partnership with our AI engineering team. You will be the vital link between client vision and technical execution. This role requires a seasoned professional who can confidently engage with VP and C-suite executives, quickly diagnose business needs, secure trust, and drive complex AI transformation projects to successful completion. You will apply your structure, rigor, and follow-through to empower our highly technical engineering team, optimizing how we coordinate, communicate, and deliver value. This is a high-visibility, career-accelerating opportunity with direct interaction with senior leaders at major companies.
Key Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders—from department heads to C-suite executives—maintaining a proactive communication cadence and ensuring tight alignment across all parties.

  • Build and manage project plans, implementation roadmaps, and phased delivery timelines; proactively identify gaps, risks, and dependencies before they become problems.
  • Own creation and quality control of all client-facing deliverables (strategic decks, status updates, project briefs, workflow diagrams), ensuring they are polished, structured, and on-brand.
  • Translate client needs into clear requirements for the internal engineering team, bridging the gap between business context and technical execution.
  • Oversee delivery quality through solution reviews, client feedback loops, and iteration cycles—ensuring outputs meet the bar and match what was promised.
  • Drive execution across multiple concurrent engagements by tracking deliverables and timelines, driving follow-ups and next steps, securing client inputs on time, escalating risks early, and keeping projects on track.
  • Help establish and refine internal processes, templates, and communication standards that allow the team to scale without losing quality or speed.

Requirements

Experience:
  • 3-5+ years of experience in client services, account management, or project management at a consulting firm, agency, or technology services company.
  • Proven track record managing client relationships with senior stakeholders (director-level and above), ideally with exposure to C-suite engagement.
  • Background at a top-tier agency, management consultancy, or technology implementation firm strongly preferred.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
  • Comfortable managing ambiguity and biasing toward action—you identify gaps, propose solutions, and move things forward rather than waiting for direction.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills, with the ability to distill complex information for diverse audiences and present confidently to senior leaders. No AI or technical background required—curiosity and willingness to learn are what matter.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills—you are the person who brings structure to ambiguity, creates the tracker before anyone asks, and never lets a detail fall through the cracks.

Benefits

What We Offer:
  • Hands-On AI Learning – No AI consulting background needed. You’ll learn from a team of experts and gain fluency in the fastest-growing industry in the world.
  • Outsized Career Growth – We’re scaling fast. Early team members have a real path to leadership as the company grows.

  • Executive Exposure – Regularly interface with C-suite leaders and department heads at major companies—visibility you wouldn’t get at a larger firm for years.
  • Flexible Work Environment – Remote-first with a results-driven approach.

raw.description:
It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Our Accounts Receivable Analyst is responsible for the collection of client receivables in accordance with contractual agreements. This includes review, maintenance and resolution of disputes, review of Clinical Trial revenue and expenses, review of study accounts receivable aging, patient accounts and pass through invoices, study finance trackers, patient trackers and contracts, as well as interaction with various departments in order to determine the validity of charges as well as the collection of those charges from sponsors.

Additionally, this position provides assistance to the Finance and Budget & Contracts departments on specifically identified projects and tasks listed below. This often involves analyzing multiple documents and often complex data to determine collectability of receivables.

This is a fully remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Monitor assigned accounts: review aging, look for irregularities, non-payments, and delayed payments in customer accounts

  • Contact Sponsors/CROs via phone to follow on unpaid/open invoices and ensure timely payments are received

  • Investigate and resolve sponsor, patient and customer disputes

  • ​Maintaining a strong business relationship with the Sponsors/CROs as the primary contact and voice for Sarah Cannon Research Institute in regards to payment of receivables

  • Reconcile financial study data with data provided by Sponsors/CROs as needed.

  • Review, interpret and discuss contracts internally and with clients to assist with resolving payment or dispute issues

  • Review medical procedure invoices in relation to the contracts to determine eligibility for reimbursement of costs

  • Identify, report on and work with supervisor to resolve trends that negatively impact payment or workflows

  • Work with other departments (i.e. Accounting, Treasury, Contracting) to resolve billing questions as needed.

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications for success include:

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred, experience may be substituted for education

  • 1+ year work experience reading and comprehending complex documents and identify financial impacts

  • Clinical Research experience highly preferred

  • Understanding of clinical financial systems and EMRs

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 750 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA today. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are actively enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 250 locations in 24 states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates.

McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
About the Role

As our SEO Expert, you will take full ownership of SEO strategy and execution for a portfolio of e-commerce clients. This is a client-facing role that combines strategic responsibility with hands-on implementation.

You will be responsible for developing, executing, and continuously improving SEO strategies that drive measurable organic growth. This role requires you to think ahead, identify risks early, and solve problems before they impact performance or client confidence.

You will work autonomously on day-to-day client work while collaborating closely with the Marketing Manager on strategic direction, complex challenges, and innovation within our SEO offering.

Mission Statement

The primary mission of the SEO Expert is to ensure that client SEO strategies are executed effectively, proactively, and with measurable business impact. This means anticipating challenges, adapting to changes in search behavior, and consistently delivering strong organic growth for e-commerce clients.

General Responsibilities

  • Develop and own data-driven SEO strategies tailored to each client’s e-commerce business goals.
  • Manage multiple SEO client accounts and take full responsibility for strategy, execution, and outcomes.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, technical audits, and content planning to support long-term organic growth.
  • Implement on-page, technical, and off-page SEO improvements across client websites.
  • Optimize product pages, category structures, internal linking, and site architecture for large e-commerce catalogs.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, designers, and marketers to ensure SEO recommendations are implemented correctly.
  • Adapt SEO strategies to the evolving search landscape, including optimization for LLM-powered search, AEO, and GEO.
  • Proactively identify SEO risks, technical issues, and growth opportunities before they impact performance.
  • Monitor performance using analytics and SEO tools and refine strategies based on data and results.
  • Prepare clear, actionable reports and recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Translate complex SEO data and findings into practical insights clients can understand and act on.
  • Maintain structured documentation of SEO work, decisions, and progress across accounts.
  • Stay up to date with SEO trends, algorithm changes, and emerging best practices in search and e-commerce.

Overall, this role exists to ensure Hustler Marketing's web projects remain structured, efficient, and commercially sound.

Position Specifications

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months

Requirements

About You

Profile

You are an experienced SEO professional with a strong background in e-commerce and agency work. You are comfortable owning client strategies end to end and are confident making decisions, prioritizing work, and communicating clearly with clients.

You combine analytical thinking with practical execution. You are proactive by nature and do not wait for problems to surface before taking action.

Key Traits for This Position

  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with a strong problem-solving mindset.
  • Proactive and forward-thinking, able to anticipate challenges and opportunities.
  • Structured, organized, and reliable in execution.
  • Client-focused, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a wider team.

Key Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience delivering SEO strategies for e-commerce websites, with approximately 4 to 5 years of hands-on SEO work focused on driving organic growth for online stores.
  • Proven track record of developing, executing, and iterating SEO strategies that lead to measurable improvements in organic traffic, rankings, and revenue.
  • Experience providing SEO services in a client-facing capacity, ideally working with clients based in the United States and understanding the expectations, communication style, and performance standards of that market.
  • Previous experience working in an agency environment or as a freelancer managing multiple SEO clients simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize work and maintain consistent quality across accounts.
  • Strong technical SEO expertise, including a deep understanding of site architecture, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and common technical challenges affecting e-commerce websites.
  • Hands-on experience working with major e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, or similar platforms, and understanding the platform-specific SEO considerations involved.
  • Experience optimizing for modern and emerging search environments, including familiarity with AI-powered search, LLM-driven discovery, Answer Engine Optimization, and Generative Engine Optimization.
  • High proficiency in SEO and analytics tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console, with the ability to use these platforms efficiently to diagnose issues and uncover opportunities.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex datasets, audits, and reports into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for both internal teams and clients.
  • Strategic and forward-thinking mindset, with the ability to anticipate algorithm updates, industry shifts, and changes in search behavior rather than reacting to them after impact.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to work independently, take ownership of challenges, and move work forward without constant oversight.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple client accounts, initiatives, and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining structure and attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with confidence presenting strategies, results, and recommendations to clients in a clear and professional manner.
  • Highly communicative, proactive, and reliable work style, with a strong sense of ownership, transparency, and accountability for assigned client accounts.
  • Comfort working autonomously in a remote or distributed team environment, while collaborating effectively with colleagues when needed.
  • Openness to feedback and continuous improvement, with a willingness to adapt and refine your approach over time.
  • Must be available and responsive during standard office hours in Slovenia and able to consistently work full-time.
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a reliable laptop or PC suitable for professional SEO work.

We’re looking for a Senior Motion Designer with strong motion and editing skills to join our team and elevate our short-form paid and social video content.

Binance is the world’s leading cryptocurrency super app, serving 300+ millions of users globally with a secure platform to trade, invest, and manage digital assets. The Global Creative Team shapes how Binance shows up in the world—developing high-impact campaigns, brand systems and creative assets that communicate innovation, trust, and accessibility at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Animating short-form videos with strong performance focus across various social channels (Meta, YouTube Shorts, TikTok)

  • Editing UGC and motion graphics in trend-driven formats tailored to short-form platforms

  • Collaborating with the brand, creative and paid teams to ensure seamless visual continuity between brand and marketing projects

  • Analysing competitors’ ads and social trends to stay ahead of worldwide creative patternsSenior

  • Understanding of creative performance metrics and a data-informed approach to iteration.

  • Applying a modular approach to editing: treating creative iteration like building blocks — analysing, merging, and remixing successful elements to drive result

  • Leveraging AI tools to accelerate and enhance production (image, video, SFX)

  • Proposing, testing, and iterating on new content formats based on performance insights

  • Leading and upskilling junior motion designers

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a motion designer (agency, in-house, or startup), with a strong emphasis on marketing design.

  • A strong portfolio showcasing exceptional brand and marketing design work, clear and strategic, creative thinking across a variety of channels and mediums.

  • Ability to take scripts, footage or design boards and turn them into clear engaging videos

  • Strong organisational skills and comfort juggling multiple projects with tight timelines.

  • A strong point of view on brand and visual storytelling

    • Motion graphics:

  • Exceptional proficiency in Adobe AE including plugins (animation, editing, kinetic typography, infographics)

  • Working knowledge of Premiere and CapCut

    • Graphic Design:

  • Basic skills in Figma.

  • Strong foundation in composition, typography, and visual aesthetics

    • Performance expertise:

  • Strong understanding of paid media algorithms and platform-specific formats

  • Experience working with hook-driven storytelling frameworks

  • Strong visual awareness and up-to-date trend sensitivity

    • AI Tools:

  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Higgsfield, LTX, Midjourney, Runway, ElevenLabs, Kling, and similar AI platforms

    • Good to have skills:

  • Strong storyboarding / storytelling skills (preparing boards for animation)

  • Basic sound design skills

  • Ability to use sound effects strategically to enhance engagement and retention

  • UX/UI design
